gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Stretched, widely spaced and unshaded: that is Nulshock all over. Noto Sans Tai Le, a sans-serif, tapers its ink strokes before they touch, so paragraphs glide along softly with barely any step up to capitals.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-tai-tha: Nulshock draws strokes like a bent paperclip, stretched wide and outlined without any shading. Noto Sans Tai Tham handles the steady reading, its lowercase climbing toward the capital line, while the heading grabs attention.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-tai-vie: Noto Sans Tai Viet is a plain sans with short ascenders and a tall x-height, its terminals pulled back from each curve. Nulshock makes the statement, no hairlines anywhere; the text does the reading.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-takri: Nulshock builds its stretched capitals from lines of one constant thickness, spaced wide and left unshaded. Noto Sans Takri leaves every small round letter generously unclosed, giving the bold lettering an open partner below.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Wide and unshaded: Nulshock stretches its capitals with spaced-out tracking and a stroke width that never changes. Beneath it, Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified, terminals stopping far from the stem.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-tamil-s: Crossbars matching the upright stems in weight give Nulshock a stretched, technical look. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement, with round forms like open parentheses and a stocky middle band, feels clean and contemporary beside it.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Nulshock holds a steady line with no pressure variation, stretched wide and spaced out. And Noto Sans Tangsa opens its round letters wide and keeps ascender stems short, an approachable counterweight.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-tc: Technical and bold, Nulshock stretches its letters wide, with strokes like twine pressed into a flat surface. Noto Sans TC does the quieter job, its curves opening outward instead of curling in.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-thaana: A tube-like thickness that holds through every bend defines Nulshock, stretched wide with generous spacing and no shading. Noto Sans Thaana adds welcome: wide channels leading into every counter.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-thai: An n whose arch matches its stem sets Nulshock apart, stretched wide and drawn as an unshaded outline. Nulshock grabs the eye; Noto Sans Thai, bead-like, carries the text.
